purpose: Define how one canonical repository object may be projected into geography, network, time, evidence, Axis, facet and interpretive views without creating parallel truth sources or inventing information during representation changes.
core_rule: Canonical owners retain identity, meaning, evidence and timeline. Views may select, aggregate, spatialize, summarize, compare or transform representation, but must not silently rewrite the underlying record.

coordinates.A: Axis transformation or analytical depth, D1-D11 where useful
coordinates.F: facet/category filter such as infrastructure, law, history, language or institutions
coordinates.C: context or interpretation set: empirical, project-canon, biblical, comparative mythology, scientific analogy, scenario, creative

state_vector.identity_invariant: Changing view should preserve the canonical object ID and a path back to its owner unless the operation explicitly creates a derived aggregate.
state_vector.time_invariant: A view must not make a historical state appear current merely because it is spatially convenient.
state_vector.epistemic_invariant: A project-symbolic or comparative interpretation must not become empirical merely because it is rendered beside empirical data.

world.primary_question: Where is it and what observable systems surround it?

network.primary_question: What is connected to what, by which typed relation, direction, value, date and source?

time.primary_question: When was this true and how did it change?

roots.primary_question: What sources, history, residue and dependencies underlie the present representation?

feedback.primary_question: Which loops, incentives and persistent ties make a relation self-reproducing or hard to exit?

threshold.primary_question: What condition, choice, boundary or authorization changes the system into a different regime?

return.primary_question: What returns, and what changed between recurrences?

branch.primary_question: What downstream branches, capabilities, descendants, consequences or fruit were generated?
forbidden: using symbolic fruit as empirical outcome without a metric

rooms.primary_question: How can differentiated subsystems compose without losing identity, agency or viable boundaries?

relay.primary_question: What is transmitted, through whom or what, with what fidelity, delay, verification and distortion?

integrate.primary_question: What larger system emerges, what can actually be observed or steered, and where are the leverage points?

meta.primary_question: What survives changes of representation, and which criteria should judge competing orientations?
forbidden: using meta-view as escape from empirical consequences

symbolic_context.primary_question: Which project, biblical, mythological, artistic or scientific-comparator relations illuminate the selected object without becoming its empirical evidence?

operators.Eye: observe/inspect/compare/source-check; changes E and visible observables without claiming omniscience
operators.Door: guarded transition between states/views; must show the condition and preserve provenance
operators.Axis: changes analytical depth or description coordinate A; distinct from ordinary chronological time T
operators.Spiral: compares recurrence with changed state; requires a delta
operators.Tree: expands one node/event/source into branches, descendants or downstream consequences
operators.Mountain: compresses many details into a higher-order system view and must report information loss
operators.Garden: tests viability, autonomous capacity, coexistence and generativity under constraints
operators.Swamp: tests feedback, capture, recurrence, opacity and blocked exit on relations rather than territories
operators.Forge: shows transformation under pressure with explicit inputs, transition and outputs
operators.HouseRooms: shows modular composition and boundaries among differentiated subsystems
operators.NorthOfNorth: compares orientation criteria and invariants; must descend back to D4 consequences

projection_contract.rule: Every nontrivial projection should be reversible at the navigation level even when mathematically information-losing: the user must be able to return to the source record and see what was omitted.

derived_aggregate_rule.boundary: Derived aggregates are views/analysis products, not canonical facts unless separately promoted under the archive's claim lifecycle.

cross_domain_examples.D4: physical infrastructure, generation, interconnectors and official energy observations
cross_domain_examples.D3: source history, ownership changes, policy timeline and prior dependencies
cross_domain_examples.D2: dependency concentration or lock-in only if measured/documented
cross_domain_examples.D5: a policy, interconnector, market-rule or investment threshold
cross_domain_examples.D8: shared Nordic/European system with retained national autonomy
cross_domain_examples.D11: criteria such as resilience, cost, autonomy, sustainability and peace

cross_domain_examples.D3: first attestation, source, prior/later role formulations and contradictions
cross_domain_examples.symbolic: project theology/comparative context; not empirical proof of supernatural identity

cross_domain_examples.D4: real historical/sacred geography only where the research question warrants it
cross_domain_examples.D5_D9: functional comparison such as Door/Ladder/message only as comparative context
cross_domain_examples.rule: Do not spatialize a verse merely because it has symbolic importance

cross_domain_examples.D4: platform/company jurisdiction or real events when relevant
cross_domain_examples.D2: feedback/capture indicators only where evidence supports them
cross_domain_examples.rule: network topology usually matters more than world-map geography

cross_domain_examples.D4: documented financial/legal instrument, debtor/creditor, amount, currency, maturity and jurisdiction
cross_domain_examples.D2: capture only if exit/dependency dynamics are evidenced
cross_domain_examples.symbolic: project karmic/moral ledger remains separately typed and never added arithmetically to financial debt

implementation_sequence: 1. Add a global Time control using valid_from/valid_to/as_of rather than embedding timeline inside Axis dimensions.
2. Generalize Trace from country-only edges into normalized entity-aware traversal with epistemic and time filters.
3. Add a visible Evidence/Eye control for source class, confidence, contradiction and first-attestation inspection.
4. Make D3 roots work for relationships and entities, not only countries.
5. Make D6 Spiral compare two dated states and show a delta instead of only rotating the camera.
6. Make D7 Tree expand real downstream dependencies/descendants/capability outputs.
7. Make D8 Rooms compose selected systems through typed interfaces and shared capabilities.
8. Make D9 Relay visualize real source-mediator-recipient or infrastructure/data/message chains.
9. Make D10 Mountain produce declared aggregates with information-loss and assumption panels.
10. Make D11 compare criteria/invariants across projections and require links back to D4 evidence/outcomes.
11. Keep symbolic comparative scenes lazy-loaded and nonspatial unless real geography adds explanatory value.
12. Add scenario/programme mode only after time/evidence/entity traversal are stable enough to distinguish observed state from modeled intervention.
